lines.beaver_en: Did you decide on the topic for this special feature?
lines.learner: 네, 혁신적인 우주 기술 특집으로 하려고요.
lines.en: Yes, I'm thinking of a feature on innovative space technology.
lines.roman: ne, hyeoksinjeogin uju gisul teukjibeuro haryeogoyo.

lines.learner: 인공위성 조립 과정과 궤도 진입을 다루려고요.
lines.en: I plan to cover satellite assembly and entering orbit.
lines.roman: ingongwiseong jorip gwajeonggwa gwedo jinibeul daruryeogoyo.

lines.en: Yes, I'll include satellite chips and software too.

lines.beaver_en: It'd be nice to have a space telescope story too.
lines.learner: 망원경 활용 사례는 연재로 다루면 좋겠어요.
lines.en: It would be good to cover telescope use cases as a series.
lines.roman: mangwongyeong hwaryong saryeneun yeonjaero darumyeon jokesseoyo.

lines.beaver_en: Will readers be able to understand it?
lines.learner: 기술적인 용어는 독자가 쉽게 읽게끔 풀어 쓸게요.
lines.en: I'll explain technical terms so readers can read them easily.
lines.roman: gisuljeogin yongeoneun dokjaga swipge ilkkekkeum pureo sseulgeyo.

lines.beaver_en: Will you get an expert contribution too?
lines.learner: 네, 연구소 박사님께 기고를 부탁해 두었어요.
lines.en: Yes, I've already asked a researcher at the institute to write one.
lines.roman: ne, yeonguso baksanimkke gigoreul butakae dueosseoyo.

lines.beaver_en: How was the response to the last electric car article?
lines.learner: 좋았어요. 현장을 안 보고서는 못 썼을 거예요.
lines.en: It was good. I couldn't have written it without seeing the site.
lines.roman: joasseoyo. hyeonjangeul an bogoseoneun mot sseosseul geoyeyo.

lines.beaver_en: Then shall we go report on site this time too?
lines.learner: 네, 다른 언론사보다 먼저 현장에 가 봐요.
lines.en: Yes, let's get to the site before other press outlets.
lines.roman: ne, dareun eollonsaboda meonjeo hyeonjange ga bwayo.

lines.beaver_en: When can we publish the article?
lines.learner: 다음 달 초에 게재하면 인지도도 오르리라 봐요.
lines.en: If we publish early next month, our recognition will surely rise.
lines.roman: daeum dal choe gejaehamyeon injidodo oreurira bwayo.

lines.beaver_en: Great. Then let's write the draft together.
lines.learner: 네, 혁신이 잘 보이게끔 멋지게 써 봐요.
lines.en: Sure, let's write it well so the innovation really shows.
lines.roman: ne, hyeoksini jal boigekkeum meotjige sseo bwayo.
